1.text: Zaburi ya Asafu.Mana, abanyamahanga baje mu mwandu wawe,Bahumanije urusengero rwawe rwera,Bashenye i Yerusalemu bahagize ibirundo.

2.text: Intumbi z'abagaragu bawe bazihaye ibisiga byo hejuru ngo bizirye,Inyama z'abakunzi bawe bazihaye inyamaswa zo mu isi.

3.text: Amaraso yabo impande zose z'i Yerusalemu bayavushije nk'umena amazi,Ntibabona gihamba.

4.text: Duhindutse igitutsi ku baturanyi bacu,Ibitwenge no gukobwa by'abatugose.

5.text: Uwiteka, uzageza he kurakara iteka ryose?Ishyari ryawe rizaka nk'umuriro?

6.text: Suka umujinya wawe ku mahanga atakuzi,No ku bwami bwose butambaza izina ryawe.

8.text: Ntiwibuke gukiranirwa kwa ba sogokuruza ngo ukuduhore,Imbabazi zawe zitebuke kudusanganira,Kuko ducishijwe bugufi cyane.

9.text: Mana y'agakiza kacu udutabare,Ku bw'icyubahiro cy'izina ryawe,Udukize utwikire ibyaha byacu ku bw'izina ryawe.

10.text: Kuki abapagani babaza bati“Imana yabo iri he?”Guhōrera amaraso y'abagaragu bawe yavuye,Kumenyekane mu bapagani imbere yacu.

11.text: Kuniha kw'imbohe kuze imbere yawe,Nk'uko ukuboko kwawe gukomeye,Kiza abategekewe gupfa.

12.text: Kandi witure abaturanyi bacu karindwi,Ibitutsi bagututse Mwami.

13.text: Natwe abantu bawe, intama zo mu cyanya cyawe,Tuzabigushimira iteka,Tuzerekana ishimwe ryawe kugeza ibihe byose.
